description: Verifies GST/QST were calculated correctly per Revenu Quebec's current (non-compounded) formula, and flags whether a French invoice version is present per Charter of the French Language s.57/89/91. Pure arithmetic + text check; not legal or tax advice.

english_text.description: The invoice's primary/other-language text (optional but needed for the language check).

french_text.description: The invoice's French text, if any (optional -- its absence is itself flagged).

gst_amount.description: GST amount as shown on the invoice.

qst_amount.description: QST amount as shown on the invoice.

name: post_quebec_invoice_compliance_check
